general.title: General
general.description: Installation settings that apply to everyone, without restarting the server.
general.publicBaseUrlHint: The address people use to reach Aphel. It is the base of every link sent by email (invitations, password resets, notifications). With https, the session cookie is marked as secure.
general.insecureWarning: The address uses http: the session cookie is not marked as secure. Use https in production.
general.maxUploadMbHint: Applies to attachments, imports and emails. Also adjust the reverse proxy limit.

mail.title: Outgoing email
mail.description: SMTP server used for invitations, password resets, notifications and reports. The password is kept in the secret vault and is never shown.
mail.notConfiguredDescription: System emails are not being sent. Invitations and password resets show a link to copy until SMTP is configured.
mail.unavailable: The SMTP provider is not available in this installation.
mail.testHint: Use "Test" with sending an email checked to receive a test message at your own address. On errors, the server message (authentication, TLS or connection) appears in the result.
mail.copyableLinkDescription: Outgoing email is not configured. Copy the link and hand it over through another channel.

storage.title: File storage
storage.description: Where attachments, exports and backups are kept. Downloads always go through Aphel, with permission checks.
storage.driverChangeWarning: Changing the type does not copy existing files: they stay in the previous storage.
storage.pathHint: Relative to the server working directory. Server and worker must see the same folder.
storage.endpointHint: For compatible services (MinIO, SeaweedFS, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2). Empty uses AWS.
storage.secretConfigured: Configured. Leave blank to keep it.
storage.forcePathStyle: Address the bucket in the path (MinIO, SeaweedFS)
storage.testOk: Connection works: the test file was written, read and deleted.
